recoverable_direct_bootstrap.request: Keep the single canonical MacPublisherBootstrapRequestV1 IH-only FD3 request and response. Do not serialize authorization, scope, attempt, locator, manifest, or time through ordinary stdin/argv/env/file carriers.
recoverable_direct_bootstrap.attempt_key: After existing peer, terminal and install-provenance admission, derive a fixed key from the authority domain, canonical IH commitment, admitted requester/control principal, selected prefix, install-provenance digest, and source commit/tree/ref. The caller supplies none of these beyond the already-admitted IH request.
recoverable_direct_bootstrap.retained_record: Add a separate System-Keychain, no-follow, CAS-updated MacPublisherBootstrapAttemptIndexV1/MacPublisherBootstrapAttemptLocatorV1 (names may be adjusted locally) under the existing fixed service/account conventions. It is not a LifecyclePublisherProtectedStateV1 field.
locator_fields: bounded canonical response bytes or response digest plus exact reconstructable sources
recoverable_direct_bootstrap.transaction: On absent key, allocate and persist the locator by CAS before authorization/key/capsule effects. On exact incomplete or completed key, reopen the original attempt and return/reconstruct the byte-identical response; never allocate a replacement UUID/time. Concurrent exact requests converge. Corrupt, mismatched, expired-incomplete, ambiguous, or nonrecoverable states preserve and block.
recoverable_direct_bootstrap.boundaries: No second FD, frame, endpoint, transport, caller locator, generic retry broker, ambient discovery, or complete-authorization serialization. Retained terminal confirmation and all existing FD3 peer/image/admission checks remain mandatory.

post_pm_transaction.ownership: Implement in R5 now; it is not deferred to R6. Add a closed execute_mac_post_pm_action_v1 path beneath execute_mac_managed_action_v1 for the exact role/action table already defined by the R5 recovery PLAN/SPEC and current control pack.
post_pm_transaction.pre_effect: Before any effect, exact-validate the current protected state, signed anchor, PM, manifest entry, request digest, role/action, install provenance, measured tools/artifacts, predecessors and no-follow identities. Persist a signed/authorized ManagedActionPreparedRecordV1 via protected-state CAS.
post_pm_transaction.closed_effect: Use one exhaustive typed match over only the existing allowed role/action pairs. Derive every instance, guest, host, unit, socket, binary, known-hosts, directory, ownership, mode and service target from the validated PM/manifest and fixed role rules. Use only fixed measured limactl/system tools, fixed installed/signed artifact bytes or embedded fixed unit bytes, and literal per-role command families. No caller command/path/payload, raw helper relay, generic operation string, arbitrary shell, new endpoint, or new transport.
post_pm_transaction.effects: Complete the exact existing R5 role/action set needed by lima-warm.sh and lima-stop.sh, including fixed Lima instance state, guest layout/group/membership/private-home/sentinel/binaries/units/publisher components/known-hosts and service/socket states. Internal PM-bound limactl shell/data use is permitted only as a fixed lifecycle primitive with literal role-specific operations; it is not caller-visible transport authority and does not implement R6 pairing.
post_pm_transaction.durability: Observe the effect, then durably publish signed receipt file, index, head, next signed anchor, protected-state CAS and global-admission CAS in the control-pack order before returning success. Exact retry resumes from the prepared record and existing durable artifacts. Ambiguous/mismatched observation preserves and blocks; never repeats or adopts. last-action-receipt.v1.json remains diagnostic only.
post_pm_transaction.wrappers: lima-warm.sh and lima-stop.sh must invoke only typed stage_one_create/post_pm_action requests. No raw limactl or guest-shell mutation and no generic compatibility selector.
